# `aitbc market hermes`

Run a one-shot Hermes Agent prompt via a software offer and pay metered escrow.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc market hermes [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--offer-id-or-plugin-id` | text | — | yes | The Offer id or plugin id. |
| `--prompt` | text | — | yes | The prompt to send to Hermes Agent. |
| `--max-time` | integer | `300` | no | Maximum wall-clock execution time in seconds (default 300). |
| `--track` | flag | `false` | no | Create a coordinator job record after a successful run |
| `--proposer` | text | — | no | Override the escrow node-wallet address (defaults to the node wallet advertised at /health) |
| `--output` | choice | — | no | Output format (alias for --format) |
| `--format` | choice | — | no | Output format |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc market hermes --offer-id-or-plugin-id <offer_id_or_plugin_id> --prompt <prompt>
aitbc market hermes --offer-id-or-plugin-id <offer_id_or_plugin_id> --prompt <prompt> --output json
```
